plan.title: Reject Vendor A Bid with Rebid Allowed

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ evaluation event on its summary page as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before opening the prepared event.
Confirm the prepared event summary screen is ready.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where Vendor A's bid can be rejected.
Confirm the Responses screen is ready before acting on the bid.
Open the rejection dialog for Vendor A's bid.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Confirm the dialog identifies Vendor A and asks for rejection confirmation.
Enable the seller's ability to submit another bid.
Verify the application reports successful rejection.
Open the stage's Rejected Bids list to inspect the recorded rejection.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Verify the rejection remark is recorded in the Rejected Bids list.
Return to the Master QCS to inspect the remaining active bid.
Verify the active comparison grid contains Vendor B as the remaining bidder.
